==Description==
'''Tank''' is a status effect attribute that reduces most forms of damage to 1.

==Mechanics==
The '''Tank''' attribute makes it so that most forms of damage will have their damage reduced to 1, if the enemy has the '''Tank''' attribute. The only exception to this is collision damage, which deals damage normally to such enemies. Collision damage is damage dealt by units when colliding with an enemy, though in some cases, such as the [[Trapper]]'s spike and bear traps, some regular towers can also deal collision damage with their regular attacks.
